notes.title: Final release and machine localization
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/974edde53f642caeef9bbdd04ea302c0dc53ba69.png[/img]

Hello everyone from the Hotbunny team! We've got some news to share regarding the project.

As we've mentioned before, we can't continue development on the sequel or other "Pirates" universe games because part of the team is on an indefinite pause. 

However, Hotbunny is eager to resume work as soon as all team members are back in action!

[b]Today, some of the team managed to implement machine translations for several languages and fixed some issues that were bugging players. From today, we're officially releasing the game from Early Access. Thanks for sticking with us and enjoying the game all this time. Here's hoping we'll return to normal operations soon![/b]

Here's what's been updated:

[b]Fixed translations for Russian and English.[/b]

Added machine translations for:
[list]
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Czech
[*] Chinese
[*] Vietnamese
[/list]

notes.title: Game price change!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

Due to the fact that we began to receive a huge number of requests and suggestions that the price of the game is too high for some regions (and in general in principle). 

That's why we changed the price of the early access game. It will be [h2]$4.99[/h2] and will remain the same price after the full release. 

Also we will not change the regional prices set by steam. I hope this way we can show that we care about our players.

We hope that the players who supported us by buying the game at the previous price will join us. All the money raised from the purchase will go towards improving the story and the speedy release of the game from early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/d98370489685f9fe94ff52995fb7c35724d39c35.png[/img]

notes.title: Important information for linux Players
notes.content:
Dear players!

We are aware of the problem of running a build with a game on linux and are working on solving this issue, but it may take a very long time.

For this we offer you several solutions:
[b][list]
[*] Launch the game from the steam folder. The game will work properly, but the achievements will not come and the played time will not be displayed. But the game content can be traversed from beginning to end without problems.

[*] Download the linux build directly from our other resource. There will also be no achievements for steam, but you will also get the current version that is here.

[*] Follow the news until the problem is solved and then purchase the game.
[/list][/b]
Also, on behalf of our small team, I would like to thank everyone who sends feedback / bugs / reviews about the game to the mail and in the discussion in the steam, thanks to you we can make our game better.

Thank you so much for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/adac5dae9c46d8593d8aab524265cd41c9ce4a52.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Early access is already here!
notes.content:
Hey, Pirates! It's done! 

Our game is now available on Steam in Early Access!

I would like to answer some questions right now:
- Game over?
The story of the first part came to a logical end, but we did not have time to implement all the ideas that we had planned, so we decided to release the game in early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/3eebca3342ff91e1fb48b386977337a8d1f6b626.jpg[/img]

- If I buy the game on steam, will I get all updates for the full version?
Yes, future updates of the first part will be released on steam at the same time as the patreon version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/c0b423fb7d78fcebb5db8ea39694aa653594c73b.jpg[/img]

- Why such a price?
We didn't want to deviate from our pricing policy, so we decided to stick to our standard price for a new version of the game (access). Also in the incentive in the game were the events "Halloween" and "Christmas" - They will not be released as separate DLC, they are included in the cost of the game in the incentive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/adac5dae9c46d8593d8aab524265cd41c9ce4a52.jpg[/img]

- What's next for us?
At the moment, we have already started working on one big DLC ​​for the first part, it will reveal to us the story of the mysterious past of the "Sea Devil". The DLC will be quite intense both in terms of scenes and plot twists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/c604e6550db3c4bb4801fd2b1fac32c18bc6b34e.jpg[/img]

Also, in parallel, we will correct and complete everything that we planned with the first part.

After the completion of the DLC, we will present to you the developments (and they already exist) for the continuation of the game (ie the second part).

Also, I want to thank everyone who took part in the development, all the patrons who have been with us all this time! Without you, we would not have reached the release of the first part of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/9aaa9157e63bb05b127c9e746d67b65bb9c50e99.png[/img]
